data.name: Amal
data.gender_notes: Amal is used as a unisex name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root أ-م-ل (ʾ-m-l), 'to hope'. Amal means 'hope, aspiration'. Its root is أ-م-ل (ʾ-m-l). A common Arabic given name. Amal is a Arabic name meaning “Hope; aspiration”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Amal expresses “Hope; aspiration”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root أ-م-ل (ʾ-m-l), 'to hope'. Amal means 'hope, aspiration'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amal total 9, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
